scoreContract.allRequirementsMet: valid terminal state, Safety 100, every applicable operational component >= 80, accurate handover

seedSelection.candidates: the nine seeds pre-registered in restaurant-fixed-workers-held-out/v1-draft, before any model was run
screen: R1 recovery earnable: on a level with an oven failure, a reference run that answers the incident with repair must record equipment_restored and recovery_order_served, so a correct recovery action cannot score 0
R2 allergy answerable: no safety_violation may occur in a reference run that verifies every allergy decision it is offered, on both a cautious-pace and a fast-pace arm
R3 distinct: the eligible-order arrival schedule must differ from every already-accepted seed on the same level
seedSelection.replacementRule: a pre-registered seed that fails the screen is replaced by the next ascending seed that passes; no seed was kept, dropped, or replaced on the basis of any score

rejected.detail: its eligible-order arrival schedule is identical to seed 101's, so the two cases would reward the same replayed sequence twice
the oven is restored but no affected heat ticket remains to serve, so recovery_order_served never fires and Recovery scores 0 even when the manager repairs immediately
order-x7 is served unverified on tick 13, the same tick its allergy_ticket:order-x7 decision first surfaces, so the safety gate fires before the manager can answer it
its eligible-order arrival schedule is identical to seed 107's

step4PolicySeparationGate.detail: adaptive outperforms passive and cautious by >= 30 mean composite points on this suite; the over-intervening spender arm loses Resources on every Quiet Tuesday case, so restraint is measured

step5MemorizationGate.detail: 'always take the first listed option' meets All Requirements on 8 of 9 cases (mean composite 96.8) versus 4 of 9 for the adaptive reference (mean composite 93.7). The scoring-optimal option is listed first in allergy_ticket (verify), oven_down (repair) and rush_wave (seat_all) in tui-gamepigeon's DECISIONS catalogue, so option order leaks the answer that Step 2 removed from the labels. Fix belongs in tui-gamepigeon: randomize option order per case seed, or otherwise break the positional signal, then re-run this screen.
